events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `tests/subsys/mgmt/mcumgr/smp_client/src/main.c` inside `test_msg_send_timeout` where `k_yield()` was called instead of `k_sleep(K_SECONDS(3))` after `smp_client_send_cmd(..., 2)`. Because `k_yield()` does not advance kernel uptime or wait for the 2-second command timeout and retries to expire, the response callback had not yet been invoked when the assertions ran. Replacing `k_yield()` with `k_sleep(K_SECONDS(3))` allows the timeout handler to run and invoke `smp_client_res_cb(NULL, &testing_user_data)`, making all tests in the `smp_client` test suite pass.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
